purpose: which activity quantity each port of the model stands for, on which basis, and what an installation would have to supply to turn it from a demonstration slot into a monitored figure. A slot is a data field, never a factor.

activity_level_rule.quote_verbatim: The activity level of a production process shall be calculated as the total mass of the goods leaving the production process during the reporting period measured in functional units and in tonnes of goods.
activity_level_rule.second_sentence: Off-spec products, by-products, waste, and scrap produced in a production process, irrespective of whether they are returned to production processes, delivered to other installations, or disposed of, shall not be included in the determination of the activity level. They shall therefore be assigned zero embedded emissions when entering another production process.
activity_level_rule.reading: the denominator of this seed is the 1000 kg of continuously cast slab that leaves the boundary, not the 1020 kg that enters the caster and not the sum of the five processes' outputs. The 20 kg of casting crop therefore appears as an output port with zero embedded emissions and no share of the activity level, which is modeling gap MG-S10 rather than a hidden subtraction.

slots.installation_data_needed: belt-conveyor totaliser reading plus the moisture and Fe assay of the same lot

slots.basis: as-fed mass, with the carbonate share declared in parameters/carbon-content.json
slots.installation_data_needed: flux weighbridge reading plus a CaCO3 assay
breeze weigh feeder plus a fuel analysis giving fixed carbon and ash

slots.basis: net calorific value convention of ST-18 definition (15), metered at the sinter plant
slots.cbam_disposition: excluded from the numerator with the ST-12 direct-only basis; the slot exists for MFA and for the PCF question
slots.installation_data_needed: revenue-grade meter reading for the reporting period

slots.basis: tapped sinter charged to the furnace, transferred inside the same production process boundary
slots.installation_data_needed: charge totaliser; the amount must equal the sinter strand output or the transfer is not internal
skip weight plus coke analysis (fixed carbon, ash, M40/M10 strength is not needed for the carbon book)
coal-powder carrier flow totaliser plus a fuel analysis

slots.basis: mass of injected gas on the pure methane reading of the hydrogen seed's catalog row; a volume reading would need the density receipt the TIDAS resolution manifest refused, which is why this seed charges mass
slots.installation_data_needed: gas meter plus the composition the operator actually fires, or the declared pure-CH4 basis kept as an explicit assumption

slots.basis: tapped liquid pig iron, the stream ST-04 makes the splitting point between the pig iron and the crude steel process
slots.installation_data_needed: torpedo-ladle weighbridge plus a hot-metal carbon and silicon analysis
slag weighbridge; the carbon that stays bound in slag must be reported through the mass balance, not through this mass

slots.basis: the same vessel charge the furnace tapped
scrap charged as the cooling agent
slots.declaration_field: the two scrap fields of ST-09, tonnes of scrap per tonne of crude steel and the pre-consumer share, are reported in parameters/sector-specific-declaration-parameters.json; the pre/post allocation is not modelled (MG-S04)

slots.basis: tap-to-tundish mass before the caster cut
ladle-treated steel delivered to the caster; no alloy, protective gas or refractory mass is authored, which is modeling gap MG-S09
slab shipped as the declared good; this is the activity level of the boundary
crop and return scrap cut off at the caster, leaving the boundary in version 1.1.0
slots.installation_data_needed: crop weighbridge plus the re-melt routing, so that a later version can close the loop instead of exporting the mass (MG-S10)

slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.slot: hot blast air volume, temperature and humidity
slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.effect: the oxygen the blast delivers is what the carbon book's two residual terms name, so the furnace node cannot close on authored mass alone

slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.slot: lance oxygen blown in the converter
slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.effect: same reading as the blast: the converter's decarburisation and slag iron oxide take their oxygen from a stream with no port

slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.slot: secondary gas cleaning reagents and their electricity
slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.effect: ST-18 counts carbonate used for flue gas cleaning as a process emission, so a version that adds the reagent must add its carbonate decomposition exchange, not a factor

slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.slot: exported blast furnace, coke oven and converter gas
slots_that_do_not_exist_yet.effect: the gas carbon is counted where it is generated, so a plant that exports gas shows a lower numerator than this model does

basis.gas_basis_note: every gas in this model is charged on mass. The TIDAS flow resolution manifest of 2026-08-31 rejected the volume-based natural gas identity for want of a density receipt, so a mass basis is the only one this seed can defend.

runtime_consumption.note: the amounts above are the same literals model/graph.json stores; this record exists so a reader can see which physical quantity each port stands for and which installation instrument would replace it.
